title: Merton Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline readiness guide for hospital A&E, urgent treatment centres, supply corridors, and flood hazards in Merton.
content: For immediate, life-threatening medical emergencies, dial 999 or 112 before doing anything else. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: St George's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT. From Colliers Wood Station: ~15 min walk north-east along High Street Colliers Wood and Tooting High Street, or bus 57, 131, or 219. St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton, SM5 1AA. From Morden Station: ~25 min walk south along London Road and Bishopsford Road, or bus 80, 93, or 157. Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB. From Raynes Park Station: bus 57 or 131 west along Coombe Lane. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Wilson Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Cranmer Road, Mitcham, CR4 4TP. From Mitcham Tram Stop: ~12 min walk north-west along London Road. 3. Local Hazards: River Wandle catchment flood zones directly impacting Colliers Wood, Phipps Bridge, and Mitcham; Beverley Brook overflow risks in West Wimbledon and Raynes Park. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and major supermarkets along Wimbledon Broadway, Mitcham Fair Green (London Road), and Morden London Road supply bottled water, baby items, and first-aid supplies during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
